items.question: Do I have to enter anyone by hand?
items.answer: No. Bookings, check-ins and form answers fill records by themselves, and you can import an old list from a CSV or Excel file to bring past guests in.

items.question: Does it work if guests didn’t book on {{brand.name}}?
items.answer: Yes. Import guest lists from a CSV or Excel file, or bring in a Luma guest list if you’re on Luma Plus, and check-ins at your door count the same.

items.question: How are regulars worked out?
items.answer: Three or more events checked in over the last 180 days. Every group shows its rule, so you know why someone is in it.

items.question: Can my team see the records?
items.answer: Owners and managers on your team can. Door staff only see the list for their event.

items.question: Can I add notes about a guest?
items.answer: Yes. Notes are private to you and your team, and never shown to the guest.

items.question: Can I export my list?
items.answer: Yes, whenever you like: export your contacts as a file.

sections.title: About the AI import.

items.question: What does the AI do with my file?
items.answer: It works out what each column means, cleans names and numbers, suggests merges and tags, and shows you all of it before anything is saved.

items.question: Is my guests’ data used to train AI?
items.answer: No. Your file is read to sort your list, and nothing else.
